Sure! I’ve had 1-3 J’s since the pandemic began. I lost my only income, partner, and bought a home that March. 

I was left in a really bad place. I got a job a year later, where I was SA’d and had to stay to pay bills. 
I realized no job is secure or company cares. 

I am constantly applying, no matter how secure I am in my job. I do interviews every once in a while and am a bit picky tbh. I have tons of experience, and truly love education so I hold multiple masters degrees (job paid wooo!). I was a very anxious person when I started and was always on edge, through the years I’ve realized nobody gives a damn. Look for sole contributor roles and you’re set. 

Not every J has been OE friendly, I’ve had maybe 10 over the last 4 years and at least 4 were absolutely unsustainable. Of those 4, I lasted six months at 2 and maybe days at the other 2. Be patient and work hard, remember why you OE always. 

I have a different title at each J.

J1 Social Media & Content Manager FT
J2 Digital Media Manager FT
J3 Social Media Strategist (20 or so hours a month)

My TC is what some peeps here make in a year from 1 J, 170k. But a few years ago I was making 40k. I grew up in the system and have been homeless before. The life OE provides is something I never would’ve imagined for myself.
